name: Comment.io
tagline: Work with people and agents in a shared Markdown workspace
description: Comment.io gives people and trusted agents a shared workspace of Markdown documents. People review drafts and comment in the browser; agents read, search, write, and suggest edits through SSH, MCP, or HTTP. Typed records support structured queries and workspace dashboards. This MCP endpoint exposes one flexible `run` tool for restricted workspace commands, including document writes, after a workspace member approves agent access.

install.notes: Cline's default OAuth flow uses dynamic client registration, which Comment.io does not offer. Comment.io requires an HTTPS client metadata document as the client ID with a matching redirect URI. A Cline connection has not been verified. See https://comment.io/auth.md or contact support@comment.io.
